newsitem.title: FRANCE: Black flag over Strasbourg in anti-Le Pen protest.
newsitem.headline: Black flag over Strasbourg in anti-Le Pen protest.

text.p: Opponents of extreme-right French politician Jean-Marie Le Pen hoisted a black flag over Strasbourg Cathedral on Friday in protest at his National Front's Easter weekend congress in the city, eyewitnesses said.

Firemen removed the flag, hung from the 142-metre (465-foot) spire of the gothic cathedral on the eve of the anti-immigration party's three-day conference, expected to draw tens of thousands of counter-demonstrators.
An anonymous telephone caller claiming to represent a group called "We shall always be in the streets" told a news agency the flag was a sign of mourning for democracy.
